title: Non-finite-coefficient derived category
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, $\ell$ a prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension, and $T\in\{\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$. Use the small pro-étale site and universe convention of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal R_{X,T}$ be the commutative ring object of [pur713-def-coefficient-rings], and put $\mathsf{Mod}(X_{\Proet},T)=\mathsf{Mod}_{\mathcal R_{X,T}}(\mathsf{Sh}(X_{\Proet},\mathsf{Ab}))$, with module objects as in [pur713-def-modules]. Give abelian sheaves their sheafified tensor product over $\mathbf Z$ [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor]. This sheaf category is abelian, its tensor is additive and preserves colimits [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-tensor-closed]; consequently [lem-sfb-modobj-abelian] supplies the abelian structure on $\mathsf{Mod}(X_{\Proet},T)$.

Define the ambient category to be its ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]:
$$
D(X_{\Proet},T):=D\bigl(\mathsf{Mod}(X_{\Proet},T)\bigr).
$$
The superscripts $+$ and $b$ denote the full subcategories of objects whose cohomology module objects vanish in all sufficiently negative degrees, respectively outside a finite interval [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories]. No derived-completeness condition, rationalization construction, or colimit of coefficient categories is part of this definition. Comparisons with such constructions require separate results.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line per clause: set C = Mod_{R_{X,T}}(Sh(X_proet, Ab)), the actual internal-module category of pur713-def-modules, with its abelian structure from lem-sfb-modobj-abelian. DerivedCategory C (Basic.lean:87) with Q (95) and Q.IsLocalization (98) is the ordinary derived category; HasDerivedCategory.standard (81) supplies localization in a sufficiently large universe. DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor and homologyFunctorFactors (Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/HomologySequence.lean:34,39) give module-object cohomology. DerivedCategory.Plus and DerivedCategory.Bounded (Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/TStructure.lean:204,207) are the full subcategories for the standard t-structure; isGE_iff (90) and isLE_iff (107) identify their bounds with the displayed cohomology vanishing. No equivalence with SheafOfModules or alternate coefficient category is used.
